Overview

A complete Webflow launch: from the Figma design to a live site, including the parts that usually fall between designer and client — SEO configuration, domain and DNS — followed by ongoing maintenance.

The challenge

Getting a site live involves more than the build. Domain, DNS and SEO settings are often where launches stall; owning them made the handoff from design to a working, indexable site a single responsibility.

Approach

  1. Build from Figma

    Implemented the Figma design in Webflow.

  2. Set up for search

    Configured SEO settings for launch.

  3. Go live

    Handled DNS and domain setup.

  4. Maintain

    Continued with maintenance after launch.
